description: Defines an abstract base class 'BaseClock' for clock implementations used in Pipecat timing operations, including method signatures for obtaining current time and starting the clock.

classes.name: BaseClock
classes.description: Abstract base class providing a common interface for clock implementations in Pipecat, with methods for retrieving current time and starting the clock.

methods.name: int get_time(self)
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the current time as an integer, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: start(self)
methods.description: Abstract method to initialize or start the clock mechanism.
